description: Services publics d'assainissement non collectif - jeux de données exploités pour les rapports nationaux Sispea is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Office français de la biodiversité. The summary data of the Information System on Public Water and Sanitation Services (Sispea) present, service by service, the fraction of the data available to the general public on the Observatory of Water and Sanitation Services ( relevant for each jurisdiction (drinking water, collective sanitation, non-collective sanitation) and required for the annual report of the ... Coverage: Office français de la biodiversité. The portal shows the English title as "Public non-collective sanitation services - datasets used for Sispea national reports" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Office français de la biodiversité. Its keywords include donnees-ouvertes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
